title: Large Top Floor Studio with Den/Office
body:
2908 Folsom Street #3 -- Cross Street: 25th Street

**EMAIL FOR VIRTUAL TOUR**

DESCRIPTION:
This bright studio is conveniently located on Folsom Street just off 25th St. On the edge of the Mission and Bernal this large studio with hardwood floors is a great place to call home! Den/Office off the main room, can even be used as small bedroom. Walk to Precita Park, Garfield Square, Dolores Park, surrounded by bars, restaurants and coffee shops. Walk out your front door onto the tree lined Folsom Street, 24th Street one block away (including Philz!).

FEATURES:
- Studio/1 Bathroom
- Updated Kitchen and Bathroom
- Hardwood Floors

NEIGHBORHOOD:
- 99 Walk Score: Daily errands do not require a car
- 84 Transit Score: Convenient for most trips
- 100 Bike Score: Mostly flat, excellent bike Lanes
- Easy access to freeways I-280, HWY101, 24th and Mission BART
- Short Walk to Valencia St, Precita Park and 24th Street

SHOWINGS:
Private Showings Available Anytime

Newly upgraded apartments ideally located in the Mission District on Valencia street between Duboce Ave. & 14th Street. Designed by Heller Manus a renowned Architects that recently received the 2023 Top Urban Planning and Design Services Company award by Real Estate Business Review Magazine. Also know for sustainable practices in his uniques design.

THE APARTMENT:
This studio residence features a well-designed floor plan to maximize space and includes a good size kitchen with ample storage and counter space, spacious main living space with large windows and a tiled bathroom with shower/tub combo.

Features Include:
Modern cabinets
Quartz counters
Stainless steel refrigerator, electric range, microwave with built-in range hood & dishwasher
Garbage disposal
Washer & dryer
Plank style flooring
Porcelain tile floor in bathroom
Double-pane insulated glass windows
Unfurnished

Building Features Include:
Virtual Doorman lobby entry system
Package room
Bike parking
Community roof deck
Google Fiber Webpass hot spots in lobby and on roof deck (service optional in apartment)
Rooftop BBQ and entertainment area
No onsite parking

RENTAL TERMS
Bedrooms: Studio
Bathrooms: 1
Deposit: Equivalent to one month's rent
12 Month Lease Term
Pets will be considered, two pet limit per residence
Utilities not included, $120/mo per unit for water, garbage and gas billed monthly by management in addition to rent. Electricity set up directly by tenant with PG&E.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
Credit Score of 680+
Monthly income of 3x the amount of rent
Positive references
